Hero.title: Choose your way to travel
Hero.subtitle: Discover Mallorca like never before. Rent a premium camper and live a unique experience of calm and luxurious adventure.

WhyUtopia.title: The Utopia Experience
WhyUtopia.subtitle: Every detail has been taken care of so that your only job is to enjoy.
WhyUtopia.reason1_desc: No fixed itineraries. You decide when to stop, when to move on. Mallorca at your own pace.
WhyUtopia.reason2_desc: Impeccable vehicles, equipped with everything you need for a luxury experience on wheels.
WhyUtopia.reason3_desc: Our team is available at all times to make sure your adventure is perfect.
WhyUtopia.reason4_desc: We offset the CO2 emissions of every rental. Enjoy guilt-free.

Experiences.title: Experiences
Experiences.subtitle: Experience Mallorca differently.
Experiences.exp1_desc: Access pristine coves that can only be reached with your camper. No crowds, just you and the Mediterranean.
Experiences.exp2_desc: Cap de Formentor, Serra de Tramuntana, the inland villages. Every curve is a new discovery.
Experiences.exp3_desc: Markets, neighborhood restaurants, pa amb oli at sunset. Mallorca is best experienced with a happy stomach.
Experiences.exp4_desc: Park where the night is darkest and the sky is brightest. The best overnight areas, selected for you.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: We answer your questions.
FAQ.q1_question: How old do I need to be to rent?
FAQ.q1_answer: You must be at least 25 years old and have had a valid driver's license for more than 3 years.
FAQ.q2_answer: Yes, all our campers include integrated GPS and Bluetooth connection with your smartphone.
FAQ.q3_answer: We accept small pets with prior notice, for an additional cleaning fee at the end of the rental.
FAQ.q4_question: What happens if there is a breakdown?
FAQ.q4_answer: We have 24/7 roadside assistance. Contact our emergency number and we will handle everything.
FAQ.q5_answer: The deposit is temporarily blocked on your card at the start of the rental and is released within 7 days after returning the vehicle in perfect condition.
FAQ.q6_answer: Yes. Cancellations more than 30 days in advance receive a 100% refund. (From 29 to 15 days: 50%. Less than 14 days: 0%).

neo.name: NEO
neo.description:
NEO is the most versatile camper in our fleet. Designed to travel and sleep up to 3 people with maximum comfort. Its smart layout makes the most of every inch to offer you a spacious living area, fully equipped kitchen, and indoor shower, making you feel at home in any corner of Mallorca.

Equipped with a panoramic skylight to sleep watching the stars, stationary heating, and high-quality natural wood finishes.

space.name: SPACE
space.description:
SPACE represents the ultimate amplitude and freedom of movement. Designed for those seeking a spacious and limitless experience. It features an optimized interior layout that allows 4 people to travel and up to 3 to sleep, ideal for families or groups of friends who want maximum comfort during their adventure on the island.

Includes a full bathroom with hot water shower, two-burner stove, large storage volume for luggage, and panoramic skylight.

AboutPage.heroTitle: More than campers. A way to travel.
AboutPage.heroSubtitle: We create spaces to move with freedom and live the journey your own way.
AboutPage.whoText1: Utopia Van Life is born with a clear idea: making camper travel simple, comfortable and truly enjoyable.
AboutPage.whoText2: No complications. No excesses. Only what matters.
AboutPage.whoText3: We design and select each model thinking about how life is lived inside, not just how it looks from the outside.
AboutPage.methodText1: We don't believe in doing more. We believe in doing it better.
AboutPage.methodText2: We take care of every detail of the interior and bet on durable and functional materials. We design spaces meant to be actually used, always looking for the balance between design and practicality.
AboutPage.philosophyText2: It should be simple: start up, move, stop when you feel like it.
AboutPage.philosophyText3: Sleep well. Be comfortable. And enjoy the road.
AboutPage.philosophyText4: That is what we look for with each model.
